502cad0107b46cc6d3bd154bbb5d32cb04c570d3.summary: CERT-UA reports a phishing campaign it tracks as UAC-0098. A password-protected ZIP holding a DOCX lure, emailed with a claimed sender of Ukraine's State Tax Service, exploits CVE-2022-30190 to load HTML and JavaScript, which then delivers a Cobalt Strike Beacon. The report lists file hashes, network indicators and a host file path.

500775ea85be6e7d6730f0f358cbbc4fc74d81a9.summary: Kaspersky Labs researchers, as reported by The Hacker News, linked a covert espionage campaign to the Chinese-speaking group LuckyMouse (also called APT 27). The campaign targeted a national data center of an unnamed Central Asian country and compromised government websites to redirect visitors to BeEF and ScanBox. The data center was infected with the HyperBro RAT, and the command-and-control server sat on a hacked MikroTik router. The initial access vector is unclear.

508e860c1d92ba3cc84f075ec204b8be1f8d67de.summary: A March 24, 2021 blog post by a security assessor describing an incident found during a client assessment. Malware on a cluster of reverse gateways collected personal data (PII) from decoded HTTPS traffic. It was split across a modified NFS-ganesha server, a patched kernel and a hooked Go application. It used NFS-based covert channels for command and control, a self-destruct command and a process watchdog. The author says there is probably a Windows component with an EDR bypass. The attackers remain unidentified, the initial access vector is withheld, and further posts are promised.
